title: [2.8.2.5-dev] Problem with the objectives 2. (dana-i) in AAPS
body:
we have installed AAPS (dev) in the middle of September. As a pump we use the Dana-i.

The Objectives 2 could not be completed all successfully.

-reduction to 90% for 10minutes
-Simulate the shower
-connect the pump again

we have now switched to the master version and simulated there with the virtual pump, that work
